title: Final distance for 227°C
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the piston distance as (5/3)L or equivalent.

title: Final pressure for 527°C
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the final gas pressure as 1.33e5 Pa or equivalent.

title: Identify initial isobaric process
description: Important: Recognizes the process is isobaric until the piston hits the left end.

title: Determine limiting temperature
description: Important: Calculates the temperature at which the piston reaches the left end (e.g., 327°C or 600 K).

title: Apply Gay-Lussac's law
description: Important: Correctly applies V/T = constant for the isobaric stage to find volume or distance.

title: Apply combined gas law
description: Important: For the constant-volume stage after the piston stops, applies P/T = constant or the combined gas law.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Uses Kelvin for all temperatures and consistent units for pressure and volume.

title: Misapply gas law to stopped piston
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assumes isobaric process for the 527°C case after the piston is fixed.

title: Sign or arithmetic error
description: Pitfall: Makes calculation errors in temperature conversion, ratios, or final numerical values.
